Statement of Purpose

/v/Bartending Purpose and Mission Statement

This subverse is dedicated to the art form, and career focus of Bartending. It is intended as educational, and fun. All content is regulated to direct discussion in a way that reflects the views of the Community as a whole. All are welcome to contribute, create content, teach a lesson, ask a question, strike up a debate and get involved.

No experience level is too low, or too high to be of value in this forum. Politeness, Courtesy, and Respect are tenets held to a very high degree of scrutiny. Runaway Threads, Harassment, Voat Manipulation, and just plain Bad Content will not be tolerated. Transparency is key, and the Mod Team is held to a very high standard, in order to maintain the integrity of /v/Bartending.

As a general rule, Bartending should be focused on in as wide a viewpoint as possible, to allow for any interpretation of value and importance to any given subject matter. High Experience level discussion is obviously welcome, though to remain accessible to any member.

  • Ask and Answer Questions
  • Maintain Decorum
  • Keep an Open Dialogue
  • Encourage Creativity
  • Focus on Education First
  • Get Involved!

All opinions are valid at /v/Bartending, as long as relevance, and integrity are maintained throughout. Get out there, share your thoughts, and most importantly - Voat! Let us know what content You want to see.

The Mod Team will be also be tasked with keeping an eye out for promising posts, in order to promote discussion, and encourage involvement. This will be prominently used to feature questions people have, in order to keep us focused on Education as a priority. The Mod Team will have oversight on content, and even feature their own if it encourages healthy discussion, and attracts the right kind of interest.

This is the Statement of Purpose for /v/Bartending subverse, to be adhered to completely, subject to content removal, or banning. This and the following rules are not subject to negotiation.

House Rules

  • Voat for content quality, not personal taste

  • Be Respectful

  • If you post a drink, please include a recipe so that others can enjoy!

  • See User Submitted Drink List Thread for rules of submission.

  • Follow Voat Rules & Regulations - See Voat User Agreement

  • Dead Links, Spam, and Low Rated Content will be removed.

  • Keep it fun, friendly, and educational!

  • If your post is deleted please make sure to read the rules carefully again, if you do not understand why your post was deleted then check the Modlog and message the moderator that deleted your post

  • You can also access the Modlogs for Deleted Comments, and Banned Users. Part of Voat's attempt at transparency, and one /v/Bartending supports.

  • Posts that show promise will be featured as a ‘Sticky,’ as a means of promoting discussion and encouraging debate. Also to get plenty of exposure to a question if someone is looking to learn something. The period of time which the post is featured will be determined by the Mod Team. Permission will not be sought to Feature a post, however, if you don't wish you content featured - you need only communicate that to the Mod Team.

This post details the Purpose of, and Rules for Involvement in the /v/bartending Subverse. I encourage you to read it, and be aware of the expectation held to all members of the forum. Fairness and Transparency will be maintained 100% by the Moderator Team, any questions or concerns can be addressed to them.
